parole.testo: From Proto-Indo-European *mesg- (“to sink”). Cognates include Latvian mazgāt, Sanskrit मज्जति (majjati, “to sink”) and Latin mergō (“to immerse”). The term has also been connected with similar words in Uralic languages, such as Võro mõskma and Hungarian mos (from Proto-Uralic *mośke- (“to wash”)), h
